description: Stop future events for an owned subscription identified by list_webhooks or create_webhook; revokes it and cancels queued deliveries. This is not a pause: use create_webhook for a new subscription. An already in-flight HTTPS request cannot be recalled. OAuth scopes: webhooks:write. Changes buyer or order state.

subscription_id.description: Subscription ID returned by create_webhook or list_webhooks for this application and buyer session. Not a delivery ID or signing secret.

name: delete_webhook
